techniques.name: Password Guessing
techniques.justification: Repeated failed password attempts targeting the root account from an external IP address with no successful session following.

techniques.name: Scanning IP Blocks
techniques.justification: Sequential port connection attempts from an external address indicate unauthorized reconnaissance/port scanning.

techniques.name: Password Guessing
techniques.justification: External brute-force password guessing against deploy account prior to success.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.justification: Successful authenticated SSH remote session established using valid account credentials following brute-force attempts.

techniques.name: Sudo and Sudo Caching
techniques.justification: User deploy invoked root shell via sudo for privilege escalation.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.justification: Large data volume (150MB) transferred to a non-standard external port (4444) commonly associated with C2 or data exfiltration.

techniques.name: Password Spraying
techniques.justification: Sequential failed password attempts across multiple distinct user accounts from a single external IP address within a short timeframe.

techniques.name: Scanning IP Blocks
techniques.justification: Sequential port connection attempts from an external address indicate unauthorized reconnaissance.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.justification: Requests containing SQL injection payloads and sqlmap user-agent signatures targeting web-srv.

techniques.name: /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow
techniques.justification: Repeated HTTP GET requests with path traversal sequences (../../etc/passwd) targeting web-srv to read sensitive files.
